name: maidan
description: Maidan worker MCP server for Cursor: claim, do and hand back tasks in your own Maidan instance. Worker-only; approvals happen in the Maidan console.

MAIDAN_URL.title: Maidan instance URL
MAIDAN_URL.description: The https:// address of your Maidan instance, with no trailing slash, for example https://maidan.example.com.

MAIDAN_TOKEN.title: Maidan worker token
MAIDAN_TOKEN.description: A worker token a workspace admin mints for you (minting needs token:admin), scoped to the work you take and with an expiry. Never paste a token:admin or non-expiring token here.
